ayahs.ar: وَالطُّوۡرِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wat-Toor
ayahs.en: By the mount

ayahs.ar: وَكِتٰبٍ مَّسۡطُوۡرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kitaabim mastoor
ayahs.en: And [by] a Book inscribed

ayahs.ar: فِيۡ رَقٍّ مَّنۡشُوۡرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fee raqqim manshoor
ayahs.en: In parchment spread open

ayahs.ar: وَّالۡبَيۡتِ الۡمَعۡمُوۡرِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wal baitil ma'moor
ayahs.en: And [by] the frequented House

ayahs.ar: وَالسَّقۡفِ الۡمَرۡفُوۡعِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wassaqfil marfoo'
ayahs.en: And [by] the heaven raised high

ayahs.ar: وَالۡبَحۡرِ الۡمَسۡجُوۡرِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wal bahril masjoor
ayahs.en: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna 'azaaba Rabbika lawaaqi'
ayahs.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَهٗ مِنۡ دَافِعٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa lahoo min daafi'
ayahs.en: Of it there is no preventer.

ayahs.ar: يَّوۡمَ تَمُوۡرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوۡرًا
ayahs.tl: Yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa
ayahs.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

ayahs.ar: وَّتَسِيۡرُ الۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa
ayahs.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

ayahs.ar: فَوَيۡلٌ يَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen
ayahs.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ فِيۡ خَوۡضٍ يَّلۡعَبُوۡنَۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon
ayahs.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّوۡنَ اِلٰي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa
ayahs.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

ayahs.ar: هٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon
ayahs.en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

ayahs.ar: اَفَسِحۡرٌ هٰذَا٘ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon
ayahs.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

ayahs.ar: اِصۡلَوۡهَا فَاصۡبِرُوۡ٘ا اَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُوۡاۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡؕ اِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِيۡمٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

ayahs.ar: فٰكِهِيۡنَ بِمَا٘ اٰتٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ وَوَقٰىهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem
ayahs.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

ayahs.ar: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيۡٓـًٔاۭ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕيۡنَ عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مَّصۡفُوۡفَةٍۚ وَزَوَّجۡنٰهُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een
ayahs.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُمۡ بِاِيۡمَانٍ اَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَا٘ اَلَتۡنٰهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ كُلُّ امۡرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen
ayahs.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰهُمۡ بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَّلَحۡمٍ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon
ayahs.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

ayahs.ar: يَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا لَّا لَغۡوٌ فِيۡهَا وَلَا تَاۡثِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem
ayahs.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

ayahs.ar: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌ لَّهُمۡ كَاَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٌ مَّكۡنُوۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon
ayahs.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

ayahs.ar: وَاَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ يَّتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon
ayahs.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
ayahs.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

ayahs.ar: فَمَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقٰىنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom
ayahs.en: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوۡهُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡبَرُّ الرَّحِيۡمُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem
ayahs.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

ayahs.ar: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَّلَا مَجۡنُوۡنٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon
ayahs.en: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهٖ رَيۡبَ الۡمَنُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon
ayahs.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُوۡا فَاِنِّيۡ مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُتَرَبِّصِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen
ayahs.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تَاۡمُرُهُمۡ اَحۡلَامُهُمۡ بِهٰذَا٘ اَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon
ayahs.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ تَقَوَّلَهٗۚ بَلۡ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

ayahs.ar: فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِحَدِيۡثٍ مِّثۡلِهٖ٘ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ خُلِقُوۡا مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡخٰلِقُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon
ayahs.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَۚ بَلۡ لَّا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon
ayahs.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ اَمۡ هُمُ الۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon
ayahs.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٌ يَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ فِيۡهِۚ فَلۡيَاۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِيۡنٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen
ayahs.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَهُ الۡبَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ الۡبَنُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon
ayahs.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon
ayahs.en: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَهُمُ الۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon
ayahs.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ كَيۡدًاؕ فَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا هُمُ الۡمَكِيۡدُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon
ayahs.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا كِسۡفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَّقُوۡلُوۡا سَحَابٌ مَّرۡكُوۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom
ayahs.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ يُصۡعَقُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon
ayahs.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا هُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا عَذَابًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَاِنَّكَ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِيۡنَ تَقُوۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
ayahs.en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَاِدۡبَارَ النُّجُوۡمِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom
ayahs.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
